title: Nippon Steel Corporation
description: Nippon Steel Corporation is Japan’s largest steelmaker and one of the world’s leading steel producers. Headquartered in Tokyo, the company manufactures and supplies advanced steel products for the automotive, construction, energy, infrastructure, and industrial sectors. Nippon Steel operates globally through a large network of subsidiaries and production facilities, with annual revenue of approximately $67 billion and more than 138,000 employees.
